event.title: Oakshire Inspires Benefit: Eugene Springfield Fire Foundation
event.description: Join us for an Oakshire Inspires Benefit from 5-8 pm, as we donate $1 per draft pour sold in our taproom to a local nonprofit!

event.title: 20th Anniversary/ Farwell Party
event.description: Join us Saturday, October 3 as we celebrate 20 years of Oakshire Brewing with a full-day block party at the Oakshire Public House! Expect live music, special beer releases, local food, family-friendly activities, vendors, pop-ups, and plenty more throughout the day.
